name: ColorSchemes
description: A collection of all the ColorScheme objects in the specified presentation. Each ColorScheme object represents a color scheme, which is a set of colors that are used together on a slide.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single ColorScheme object from the specified ColorSchemes collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single ColorScheme object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a color scheme to the collection of available schemes. Returns a ColorScheme object that represents the added color scheme.

parameters.name: Scheme
parameters.description: The color scheme to add. Can be a ColorScheme object from any slide or master or an item in the ColorSchemes collection from any open presentation. If you omit this parameter, the first ColorScheme object (the first standard color scheme) in the specified presentation's ColorSchemes collection is used.
